author: Kairos II
title: Pin canonical hybrid (w70/30 min-max), add zscore variant (w70/30)
abstract: Copy damped-dominant min-max hybrid to canonical filenames, create zscore variant for w70/30, and write a CANONICAL note.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json, shutil
from pathlib import Path

over = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/overlays')
over.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Build zscore variant (w70/30)
cmd = [
    'python',
    'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid.py',
    '--evolution_csv', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/timeseries_evolution.csv',
    '--nova_csv', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv',
    '--weights', '0.7,0.3',
    '--norm', 'zscore'
]
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)

# Locate base outputs from the just-run build (zscore)
base_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid.png'
base_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_summary.txt'
z_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_zscore.png'
z_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_zscore_summary.txt'
if base_png.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(base_png, z_png)
if base_sum.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(base_sum, z_sum)

# 2) Pin canonical to min-max damped-dominant (w70/30)
minmax_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_minmax.png'
minmax_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_w70_30_minmax_summary.txt'
canon_png = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_canonical.png'
canon_sum = over / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid_canonical_summary.txt'
if minmax_png.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(minmax_png, canon_png)
if minmax_sum.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(minmax_sum, canon_sum)

# 3) Write CANONICAL note
note = over / 'CANONICAL.txt'
with open(note, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("Canonical hybrid: damped-dominant w=0.7 (damped), 0.3 (adjusted), norm=min-max\n")
    f.write(f"panel={canon_png}\n")
    f.write(f"summary={canon_sum}\n")
    f.write("Variants also available: w70_30_zscore, w30_70_minmax\n")

print(json.dumps({
    "zscore_variant_panel": str(z_png),
    "zscore_variant_summary": str(z_sum),
    "canonical_panel": str(canon_png),
    "canonical_summary": str(canon_sum),
    "canonical_note": str(note),
    "stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-800:],
    "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]
}))
